[[File:2x04_latara_palanquin.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], carrying "Princess" [[Latara/Legends|Latara's]] palanquin.]]
{{Quote|This is the only way to travel!|"Princess" [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] on her palanquin|<ref name="2-04">{{Ewoks|Princess Latara}}</ref>}}
A '''palanquin''' was a vehicle that could be used to transport deities, royal authorities and other kinds of leaders.

The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] tribe of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] had a palanquin. It was a throne that an Ewok could use to sit down while other two Ewoks freights it. At some point, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] allowed [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] the title of Princess for only one day, in order to convince her that an Ewok princess had a life of chores, not of privileges.<ref name="2-04" />

Kneesaa commissioned her friends [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] to be the loyal servants for "Princess" Latara. But the "second princess" showed little care for Wicket and Teebo, the "peasant" servants who carried her throne around the village, under her orders.<ref name="2-04" />

==Behind the scenes==
This palanquin was showed only during the [[Ewoks (television series)|TV series]]' episode ''[[Princess Latara]]''.
